title: Day 2 of rebuilding my favorite childhood game day 3
author: takshit2
selftext:
I'm building a tower defense game Similar to Warcraft 3 custom map TTW and Element TD using ChatGPT Astra+Godot and Pixlellab MCP.

I have build the data sheets including the factions and tower information, concept art, and the core gameplay mechanics.

I'm now rendering the sprites. Here's the first animated tower I got. What do you guys think?

comments.author: WDLfootball
comments.body: That looks awesome! How did you create the animation?

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body: I used pixellab to Crete and animate it. Though I use chatgpt to build the idea. The concept comes from dung Beatle. I wanted to create a bug faction heheee

comments.author: Unturned1
comments.body:
I'm pretty impressed by the quality although you have some non-sense in the animation going on around the door opening and it forming those two connections to the barrel. It is a good animation except for how one note it is, which is a problem with timing the wind up and release all appear to be at the same speed. The other issue of course is pixel flicker. If you pause and ignore the animation when you have no lighting changes the pixels are all moving around, which is a consequence of the the diffusion model. The trick to reduce the flickering is animate smaller individual pieces they handle consistency better when you make it generate only a small piece. 

https://preview.redd.it/nraw3t94i7rh1.png?width=151&format=png&auto=webp&s=7dc151e36a818d429cbe730e818aa1d03181264f

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body: Wow thank you for the feedback! Really appreciate your attention to details. I will improve this animation. Thank you again!

replies.author: Dangerous_Serve_4454
replies.body: What do you mean "animate smaller individual pieces"? This animation was ultimately produced by minimax H3 and ran through pixellabs pixel alignment post processor.

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body: I didn't realize it. Haha yeah it really looks like metal slug

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: Thanks for the heads up about pixellab mcp, i will need to give that a shot.

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body: Yeah man. Astra + Pixellab is awesome creating sprites. I think it also fits on an RTS game!

it looks good.

Are you animating with ai or you use sprites

comments.author: HustleForTime
comments.body:
This is absolutely wild because I’ve been on the hunt for a similar TD game since the W3 custom maps.

I’ll be following closely!

comments.author: Bauxetio
comments.body:
Could tell before clicking that the sprite was AI generated, due to the nonsensical stuff here and there. I wonder if it's editable or if you're just supposed to generate another one until it looks coherent.

Or you can just decide it's good enough an keep on. I guess it's fine if one does not pay too much attention.

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body: This is just a first render from AI and I really didn't pay much attention to it. I was just so impressed with how smooth the animation is even though it's not perfect. But of course, AI can revise it!

comments.author: itsonly5am
comments.body: Looks good! How much manual manual editing did you need to do?

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body: Honesty, the only manual thing I did is building the entire idea and concept of the game. The rest are AI. I told astra the concept of this sprite and astra did it with pixellab mcp
